callout_labels: Choose the study scope before requesting preflight.
Use a stable run name because safe resume depends on the same identity.

callout_labels: Treat the ledger-derived completed count as operational progress, not as a final result.
Separate successful, failed-attempt and excluded counts when monitoring coverage.
Use Stop safely when interruption is necessary; do not terminate worker processes directly.

Resume with the exact same run name and scientific identity.
Treat an identity mismatch refusal as evidence protection, not as an error to bypass.

callout_labels: Confirm which settled run is selected before reading any number.
Read coverage and Result Status before interpreting any energy or carbon metric.
Keep each headline value with its displayed unit, period and denominator.

callout_labels: Compare a cluster's geometric and cadastral intensity as two different denominators.
Read Rai comparisons as model-to-reference research comparisons, not as measurements.
Treat the Latin-hypercube band as pilot-building context, not as a range for the totals.

callout_labels: Search by cadastral reference and apply the status filter before selecting a row.
Keep the selected row identity visible while its evidence drawer is open.
Open the readable report before consulting raw expert files.

Read the period, energy and emissions strip together with its stated denominator.
Quote any number only with the scope and limitations printed beneath it.

Read the site-energy table as original engine evidence behind the interpreted report.

Delete only a non-running run, and only after exact-name confirmation.
